title: Redirected lysis (P815 functional assay)
author: Philippa R Kennedy
materials: Optional: Label specific cell subsets prior to this assay with Cell Trace Violet (CTV) according to the manufacturer's instructions to examine the behavior of a particular cell subset. CellTrace™ Violet Cell Proliferation Kit, for flow cytometry Thermo Fisher Catalog #C34571

One hour after the addition of anti-CD107a, cells are given monensin (GolgiStop Cat. No. 554724, BD Biosciences) and brefeldin A (GolgiPlug Cat. No. 555029, BD Biosciences). GolgiStop (1/150) and GolgiPlug (1/100) are diluted in R10 and 20 μL is added to each well. Cells are incubated for a further 4 h at 37°C 5% CO 2 .
Cells are resuspended in 200 μL PBS with a dead cell marker (1/1000 dilution; Live/Dead Fixable Aqua Staining Kit, Cat. No: L-34966, Thermo Fisher) and incubated for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.

Data is analyzed using FlowJo software (Tree Star Inc., RRID:SCR_008520) Degranulation (CD107a+) and cytokine production (IFNγ+ or TNFα+) are assessed for the live (dead cell marker-) NK cell (CD56+ CD3-) population and subdivided according to cell trace labeling.

Optional: Label specific cell subsets prior to this assay with Cell Trace Violet (CTV) according to the manufacturer's instructions to examine the behavior of a particular cell subset. CellTrace™ Violet Cell Proliferation Kit, for flow cytometry Thermo Fisher Catalog #C34571

steps.title: Prepare P815 Target Cells
steps.instruction: Count and resuspend P815 cells at 2.5x10^6 cells/mL in R10 (RPMI + 10% fetal bovine serum + 1% penicillin streptomycin).

substeps.instruction: Add 100 μl (2.5x10^5 cells) per well to a 96 well U-bottom plate.

steps.title: Apply Receptor Blocking Antibodies
steps.instruction: Add anti-human receptor mAb (e.g. anti-CD16, anti-NKp30, anti-NKG2D, anti-DNAM1, anti-CD2, or mIgG1) at 1 μg/ml to individual wells containing P815 and to an equal number of wells containing R10 alone.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Add Effector Cells and CD107a Antibody
steps.instruction: While target cells are incubating, count and resuspend effector cell populations in R10.

substeps.instruction: Add 5x10^5 effector cells and anti-CD107a-FITC antibody (5 μl/well) to each well.
Ensure the final volume per well is 200 μl.
Incubate the plate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice in flow buffer (1% AB serum, 0.5mM EDTA in PBS).

substeps.instruction: Spin plate in a centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant and replace with 200 μL PBS/well (first wash).
Spin plate again at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant and replace with 200 μL PBS/well (second wash).
Spin for a final time at 300 g for 5 min and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Surface Stain Effector Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend wells in 50 μL of flow buffer containing anti-CD56-PE-Cy7 (2 μl/well) and anti-CD3-PECF594 (1 μL/well).

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 4°C for 15 min in the dark.
Top up wells to 200 μL with flow buffer.
Wash once with flow buffer.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 10 min.
Top up wells to 200 μL with flow buffer.
Wash once with flow buffer.

steps.title: Permeabilize Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 μL 0.1% Triton X/PBS.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 5 min.
Top up wells to 200 μL with flow buffer.
Wash once with flow buffer.

steps.title: Intracellular Cytokine Staining
steps.instruction: Resuspend permeabilized cells in 100 μL of flow buffer containing anti-IFNγ-BV650 (3 μL/well) and anti-TNFα-AF647 (5 μL/well).

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Top up wells to 200 μL with flow buffer.
Wash once with flow buffer.

steps.title: Collect and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 200 μL of flow buffer and transfer to bullet tubes.

substeps.instruction: Cover tubes and store in the dark at 4°C until analysis via flow cytometer (LSR II, BD Biosciences).
